name: Signature Replay
summary: Attacker captures a signed ERC-2612 permit from a different chain and replays it against VictimLendingPool on this chain. Detector matches the signatureHash against a known-used-permit set.
expectedOutcome: PendingTxEvent carries a permit selector. preemptive-strike service matches signatureHash → publishes ThreatConfirmedEvent@2 pattern=SIGNATURE_REPLAY. Defense calls Pause on the pool.

steps.text: Attacker replays permit signed on chain 42161 against our chain 31337
Pause broadcast. permit() never authorized the transfer.
